text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview Document gives the Total Approved Budget as $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states that, following a Finance Committee revision in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown also calls the $2,400,000 figure the originally approved budget.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget."}]},{"text":"The difference between $2,600,000 and $2,400,000 is $200,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"},{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document requires that budget changes above $50,000 be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"Decisions requiring budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown says the Finance Committee itself revised the budget, so the required body was involved according to that document.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026"}]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[0,1]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
